newsitem.title: USA: Dime Bancorp names Anthony Burriesci CFO.
newsitem.headline: Dime Bancorp names Anthony Burriesci CFO.

text.p: Dime Bancorp Inc said Wednesday that it named Anthony Burriesci executive vice president and chief financial officer of Dime Bancorp and its subsidiary The Dime Savings Bank of New York, FSB.
His appointment is effective on July 1, a company news release said.
As CFO, Burriesci replaced David Sparks, who left the company to pursure a private business opportunity, Dime said.
Burriesci joins The Dime from First Union Corp, where he served as executive vice president-finance and administration and chief financial officer of First Union's Northern Region, Dime said.
